init_distributed_device: initialize distributed training and set the correct GPU device for the current process
is_using_distributed: check if the current environment is configured for distributed training via WORLD_SIZE or SLURM_NTASKS
world_info_from_env: extract local rank, global rank, and world size from environment variables
is_master: check if the current process is the global or local master process
is_global_master: check if the current process has global rank zero
